name: 27612 · Raleigh, NC
findings: ZIP 27612 (Raleigh) has 218 nonprofit organizations. 106 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 89 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (12% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27612 (Raleigh) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 27612 (Raleigh) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 50 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
